opportunities.name: Internet Society Fellowship 2027
opportunities.coverage: Mentorship, travel support for a relevant Internet event, and a potential project stipend up to US$5,000. Exact travel arrangements follow programme terms.
opportunities.eligibility: Complete prerequisite training and propose a practical project in Internet policy, connectivity or safety. Global applicants; competitive selection.
steps: Enroll in free pre-fellowship training by November 22, 2026.
Complete the required modules and develop a feasible community project.
Use the application link sent after completing training.
Apply by December 18, 2026; selection is competitive.

opportunities.name: PostgreSQL Europe travel scholarships
opportunities.coverage: Approved expenses reimbursed after the event against receipts. The committee sets a maximum award; upfront travel money may be needed.
opportunities.eligibility: People facing financial or systemic barriers. Demonstrate a benefit to the PostgreSQL community; nearby events are favoured.
steps: Choose a relevant upcoming PostgreSQL Europe event.
Email diversity@postgresql.eu yourself with your request and budget.
Ask about eligibility, timing and the amount before booking.

opportunities.name: AFRINIC meeting fellowships
opportunities.coverage: The published AFRINIC-37 round offered airfare, accommodation, a stipend and travel insurance. Future awards depend on the next call.
opportunities.eligibility: Residents of African countries with an interest in Internet operations or policy. No new round is announced; the June 2026 round has finished.
steps: Watch the official page for the next meeting call.
Check the new round’s eligibility and support terms before applying.

opportunities.name: ICANN89 Policy Forum fellowship
opportunities.coverage: ICANN arranges approved economy flights and hotel accommodation, with a capped stipend and visa-cost reimbursement. Insurance and incidental hotel expenses are excluded.
opportunities.eligibility: The next round is restricted to ICANN fellowship alumni. New applicants should watch future Community Forum or Annual General Meeting calls.
steps: Confirm that you have completed an ICANN fellowship.
Create an ICANN account and apply during the November 5–December 5 window.
Review the fellowship terms and travel exclusions.
opportunities.deadlineNote: Application window opens 5 November at 23:59 UTC (6 November in Malawi). Closes 5 December at 23:59 UTC.

opportunities.name: RIPE 94 / 95 fellowship
opportunities.region: Europe, Middle East and Central Asia
opportunities.coverage: Meeting entry, approved travel, accommodation and coaching. Extra visa journeys may not be fully covered.
opportunities.eligibility: Applicants aged 18+ living in the RIPE NCC service region, working or studying Internet coordination/operations and completing RIPE 101. Malawi residents are outside this service region.
steps: Check service-region eligibility and complete RIPE 101.
Choose a learning track and submit the official application.
Confirm the travel arrangements if selected.

opportunities.name: IETF meeting registration fee waivers
opportunities.coverage: Remote registration fees can be waived for participants unable to pay. Onsite waiver requests are considered separately; travel and accommodation are not included.
opportunities.eligibility: People whose finances, employment status or lack of employer support prevent participation.
steps: Choose the upcoming IETF meeting and registration mode.
Request a remote waiver through the registration process, or contact IETF support about onsite fees.

opportunities.name: USENIX student and professional conference grants
opportunities.coverage: Conference registration and partial help with travel/accommodation, subject to funds. Awards rarely cover the whole trip and are paid after attendance.
opportunities.eligibility: Full-time students, or professionals facing barriers to attending relevant USENIX events. Current listed applications are closed; future calls are published per conference.
steps: Choose an upcoming USENIX conference.
Watch its Attend → Grant Opportunities page for the next call.
Prepare a need statement and, for students, an advisor’s statement.
Budget for upfront travel costs and wait for the award decision.

opportunities.name: ACM-W research conference scholarships
opportunities.coverage: Up to US$600 for travel within a continent or US$1,200 between continents. Some SIG conferences can also provide registration support.
opportunities.eligibility: Students in computing or related research interested in advancing women’s participation. No paper presentation is required. Grace Hopper and Tapia are excluded. One award per recipient.
steps: Choose an eligible research conference in December 2026–January 2027.
Create an ACM account and submit your motivation and conference details.
Have your advisor upload their support letter by the same deadline.
opportunities.deadlineNote: This October 15 round covers conferences December 1, 2026–January 30, 2027. Later conferences use later rounds.

opportunities.name: SIGCHI Gary Marsden Travel Awards
opportunities.coverage: Approved conference registration and travel expenses. Travel is normally reimbursed after attendance; advances can be requested for acute financial need.
opportunities.eligibility: Students, early-career researchers and people facing financial hardship attending eligible ACM SIGCHI conferences.
steps: Choose an eligible SIGCHI conference more than one month after the application deadline.
Submit a budget and explain your need through the official award form.
Request an advance if paying upfront would prevent you attending.
opportunities.deadlineNote: Next regular round: November 9 at 23:59 Anywhere on Earth. Check the application form for extensions.

opportunities.name: HPSF Conference scholarships and travel funding
opportunities.coverage: Registration scholarships and travel funding are separate applications. Travel assistance covers approved airfare, accommodation and airport transport; other costs may be excluded.
opportunities.eligibility: Open-source community members facing financial barriers, with emphasis on underrepresented groups. Review the current event page for application availability.
steps: Review the event’s current scholarship and travel-funding deadlines.
Apply for travel assistance separately if needed.
Wait for approval and confirm reimbursement requirements before booking.
opportunities.deadlineNote: Travel funding: February 21 at 23:59 EST. Registration scholarship: March 7 at 23:59 EST.
